children: Shares of digital medical services platform Teladoc Health
jumped 24.2% in the morning session after the company reported third-quarter financial results that exceeded its adjusted EBITDA guidance and reached near the upper end of its revenue forecast.

According to a company press release, Teladoc reported revenue of $605.1 million for the quarter, approaching the high end of its projected range. Adjusted EBITDA—a measure of core operating profitability—reached $79.4 million, exceeding its guidance target, while its net loss narrowed to $26.9 million. The results surpassed Wall Street expectations, as analysts expected revenue of $588.4 million and adjusted EBITDA of $68.08 million. Outperforming profit targets while reining in losses reassured investors regarding operational efficiency and reinforced confidence in the company's trajectory toward consistent profitability.
What is the market telling us

Teladoc’s shares are extremely volatile and have had 31 moves greater than 5% over the last year. But moves this big are rare even for Teladoc and indicate this news significantly impacted the market’s perception of the business.

The previous big move we wrote about was 15 days ago when the stock dropped 4.4% on the news that the major indices pulled back and tech-oriented equities fell as the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported a hotter-than-expected September inflation print, pushing Treasury yields higher.

Teladoc is up 22.7% since the beginning of the year, but at $8.65 per share, it is still trading 11% below its 52-week high of $9.72 from July 2026. Despite the year-to-date gain, investors who bought $1,000 worth of Teladoc’s shares 5 years ago would now be looking at only $57.84.
